description: A holiday tabletop vignette photographed at near eye-level with a normal lens, centered on a decorative winter village cottage displayed on a surface covered with white artificial snow. The miniature cottage is fully flocked in white and encrusted with a fine snow-like texture, covering its steeply pitched roof, side porch, and chimney stack. Evergreen sprigs adorned with red berries and a pine cone cluster the roof peak. A single pine cone rests on the snowy foreground surface. Warm amber light radiates from within the cottage windows — a tall arched doorway, several rectangular windows, and a round porthole window — each glowing with golden warmth. On the right side of the frame, a small ceramic Santa Claus figurine and a white bench are partially visible. Behind the cottage on the left, snow-flocked evergreen branches fill the frame with silvery white foliage. At the upper right background, warm out-of-focus golden bokeh circles suggest a Christmas tree strung with fairy lights. The wall behind is pale warm cream. The palette is entirely white and ivory with warm amber glows from the cottage windows and scattered golden bokeh — a pure winter-white holiday aesthetic.
